verdict.rationale: Opening URLs or file paths from output is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, but the evidence pack never documents clickable links or keyboard-driven link selection. The proxy icon (title-bar session path) and macOS Quick Look (three-finger lookup for definitions and web searches) are adjacent features that do not open URLs or paths from terminal output.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open URLs and file paths from output by clicking them or selecting them from the keyboard
